层次与深度
Flat
Depth is communicated through flat, border contrast, and reusable shadow or blur treatments. Keep those recipes consistent across hero panels, cards, and controls so the page reads as one material system.
Surfaces should read as flat first, with borders, shadows, and blur only reinforcing that material choice.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• keep spacing aligned to the detected 8px rhythm.
• reuse the Flat surface treatment consistently across cards and controls.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 没有明确理由时，不要超过检测到的极简动效强度。
动效
动效保持克制，以界面为主导，覆盖文字、布局与滚动过渡。 缓动偏好 Ease。

WebGL
WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using alpha. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: dot-matrix particle field with soft magenta on soft orange and moderate spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve dom fallback.
